phase: Phase S1: Package refresh and vinext 1.x
summary: Seven adversarial cases cover the three mandatory attacks of strategy 13.7 (R18): make next resolve again (hoisted copy, manifest fields, lockfile keys), pass the probes with any types, and drop apps/danielson from a test list or a gate. Each seeded fault is caught by the S1 guard logic: the case 2 walker and require.resolve find a hoisted next copy in a temp tree; the case 3 scanner reports next in all five manifest fields and a nested next@16.2.7 override; the extracted case 8 scanner reports node_modules/next, a nested next, the nested 0.0.55 danielson vinext copy, and a workspace entry that lists next; a shorthand ambient any module makes the push(123) probe pass, which turns the case 5b guard red, so any types cannot produce a false green; the disk-read scan reports the nested 0.x vinext copy while a danielson-filtered scan hides it, so the case 1 sentinel is load-bearing and holds; gates.sh reports NEW FAILURE when the sweep tree drops apps/danielson and when its lint script is removed. All 7 adversarial tests pass, the 11 S1 guard cases still pass, the full scripts suite holds only the known remediate-concept-blueprints baseline failure, and the PROJECT_TESTS gate (GATES_RESUME=1 GATES_BASE=baseline-m2 gates.sh test s1, with fresh re-runs of exactly the two jobs whose inputs changed) prints NEWFAIL=0 and exits 0. No blocking finding, no implementation defect, no production file changed: 831804c1..8e1bf30d holds the two test files only. No 'not applicable' mark was used on any mandatory attack.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] adversarial-testing: gates.sh does not classify a workspace tool run that fails on a transient machine write error as INFRA. A vitest run that hits EDQUOT (errno -122) exits 1, so the gate reports a new diagnostic instead of INFRA=1, and only a manual resume re-run resolves it. Rationale: the INFRA exit list (64 65 70 75 77 124 201) covers heavy-run.sh exit codes only, not in-run write errors of the tool it launches. Evidence: adversarial-gate-test-s1.log printed 'NEW FAILURE: test packages/math-content has a new diagnostic' after 89 'Unknown system error -122' write failures, and the same job re-ran clean (adversarial-gate-test-s1-run2.log, NEWFAIL=0).
